title: About | ContextMint
description: ContextMint is a local AI coding assistant — Ask, Plan, and Agent on your machine, with evidence and human approval before code changes.

hero.title: A local AI coding assistant
hero.leadAfter: for VS Code. A solo developer starts on one machine. A team sees evidence before the model answers and approves changes before they apply.

problem.title: The problem we solve
problem.p1: AI can produce changes faster than organizations can review them with evidence. Knowledge is fragmented across git, CI, docs, and ticketing. Reviewers merge with incomplete context.
problem.p2Before: ContextMint indexes the workspace, surfaces stored governance findings, and puts
problem.p2After: in front of inference and repo writes — on your infrastructure by default.
